biotools.summary: DeepO-GlcNAc is a web server for predicting protein O-GlcNAcylation sites using deep learning, offering a user-friendly platform for researchers. The tool leverages LSTM, CNN, and attention mechanisms and is available for investigation and usage by the scientific community.
